manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball slows on the way up, is still for an instant at the top, and speeds up on the way down. The gravity arrow stays the same throughout.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball moves on a fixed height scale above a launch-height guide. The blue Motion arrow shortens going up, vanishes at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow never changes.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top.
